name: What is the typical timeline for building a custom single-family home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for building a custom single-family home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a custom single-family home can vary significantly depending on factors such as design complexity, site conditions, permitting processes, and material availability. Generally, the design phase can take 3-6 months, while the actual construction can range from 12-24 months. This does not include the time required for securing financing or property acquisition. We work to establish a realistic schedule upfront and provide regular updates throughout the project to keep you informed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home construction typically takes 12-24 months, following a 3-6 month design phase. Overall duration depends on project specifics and permitting.
